regulator.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology

instruments.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1) and the Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1)

facet_hints.nature: Voluntary framework organised around four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE. It is freely published, so citations should point at the actual PDF sections.
facet_hints.generative_profile: The Generative AI Profile enumerates risks specific to generative systems, including confabulation, data leakage, and harmful bias, and is directly useful for mapping phase-4 findings.

seed_obligations.title: Establish accountability structures for AI risk
Establish the context and identify risks of the AI system
testable_as: documented intended use and misuse cases

seed_obligations.title: Measure identified AI risks with defined methods
testable_as: evaluation results for the identified risks

seed_obligations.title: Prioritise and act on measured AI risks
testable_as: a treatment decision per identified risk
incident response covering AI failure modes
